verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software or data-hosting product, so a user choosing a data storage region is a category error for this product type. Its data-privacy advisory work (e.g., the DPDP Rules commentary) and its offices in several jurisdictions are not a customer-selectable data residency capability, so they do not make the axis applicable.
